name: pe64 Proto-Elamite ration ladder (frozen 6 Oct 2026)
units: capacity in N39C (N39C 1 : N30D 2 : N30C 4 : N24 12 : N39B 24 : N01 120 : N14 720); counts in units

rungs.evidence: cycle 1 held-out half AB: 10 tablets vs swap null 3.5 (p 0.005); BA p 0.03-0.04; repeats pe27/pe28/pe32/pe63

candidates.evidence: BA only, 10 vs 5.5 (p 0.045), no marker sign

not_rungs.48: single direction, p 0.01 on 1 tablet; killed independently by pe66 F6
not_rungs.M340: one name line on 5 tablets of one record type, not a grade term

ladder: none: one rung only; no pair of rungs in a simple ratio
power: a rung needs about 10 tablets (5 per half) to be seen: planted 10/rung 6 of 6, 5/rung 1 of 6, 3/rung 0 of 6; Ur III at PE size returns its top rung and term but not women/children

predictions.text: On tablets not in this corpus, a count line ending in M054, M388 or M124 followed by a bare M288 line has M288 = 60 N39C x count.
predictions.support: >= 1 in 3 of at least 6 such new pairs
predictions.kill: < 1 in 6 of at least 6 new pairs

predictions.text: No second per-unit rung (any rate other than 60) appears on >= 10 new tablets after count lines of the M054/M388/M124 class.
predictions.support: no such rung in >= 100 new count->capacity tablets
predictions.kill: a rung of 30 or 20 (1/2, 1/3 of 60) after one sign class on >= 10 new tablets would be the missing ladder and would overturn the one-rung finding
